_comment: To add images to rule sections, add an 'image' field with the path to your image file. Images should be placed in the 'images/' folder. Example: 'image': 'images/your-image.jpg'
title: Pool Tournament Rules

sections.title: Tournament Format
content: The tournament consists of two stages: Group Stage and Knockout Stage
Group Stage uses Swiss format with multiple rounds
Top 2 players from each group advance to knockout stage

sections.title: Group Stage Rules
content: Players are divided into groups of 3-4 players each
Swiss pairing system ensures fair matchups
Each round, players face opponents with similar records
Tie-breakers: Head-to-head record, then opponent strength

sections.title: Match Rules
content: All matches are single games (race to 1)
Players must call their shots clearly
